Highland Avenue: 60 ft N-S leg ('Highland Av. (in East Walnut Hills)'), then a 30 ft diagonal leg (also labelled Highland Av.) that ends at Ashland. Edgecliff Road ('EDGECLIFF R'D', 50 ft) runs off the mapped area at page y~3545 (mapping limit, onto sheet 330), not a real dead end. Francis Lane turns at the Edgecliff junction and continues page-right (south) onto sheet 330. Minnehaha also appears to continue page-right past the Ashland T (only its west side drawn, as the mapped-area edge), centre not pickable. Printed 'S. Elm St.' recorded as South Elm Street.
